notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.1.3 - Poll: the Log labels traffic with the connected device (it showed the device on screen) and decodes frames with the connection's TCP/RTU format. Revert, like Write, works on edited rows when nothing is checked. Slave: the status bar no longer says Master online after the master has left. Linux: first release where updating from it shuts the old AppImage down cleanly.
